subject: File control entry
notes: Rule: 'If no COLLATING SEQUENCE clause is specified: a) the collating sequence for alphanumeric record keys, both primary and alternate, is the native alphanumeric collating sequence; b) the collating sequence for national record keys, both primary and alternate, is the native national collating sequence.' (cite.py --check 12.4.5.3 -> OK 6) a)). Code: ResolveFileCollating falls through to native (null weights = ordinal) when no Format-1/Format-2 clause names the key (GR4/GR5 of §12.4.5.7.4 per its doc). Probes (--std 2023): probe/fce/gr6nat_x (alphanumeric prime key, no clause) walks 11, AA, BB, ZZ, aa = native ordinal; probe/fce/gr6pcs_x (same + OBJECT-COMPUTER PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV) walks the SAME native order - the program collating sequence does not leak into key order; probe/fce/gr6nat_n (PIC N(2) prime key) walks native national order; alternate keys: probe/fce/gr6alt_x2 (alphanumeric alternate, PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE REV, START >= spaces) walks 11, AA, BB, ZZ, aa, and probe/fce/gr6alt_n (national alternate) likewise. All four quadrants (primary/alternate x alphanumeric/national) verified. No spec-derived golden pins the no-clause default by name; test-needed. [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 per the clause text; b) (national record keys) applies where national data exists (2002+)]
